name: Surprise Spread
description: A layered seafood dip with shrimp, cocktail sauce, and cheese.
recipeIngredient: 3 (4 oz) cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
Tortilla chips or assorted crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Spread this mixture in the bottom of a deep pie plate, pizza pan, or shallow baking dish.
Scatter the shrimp over the top.
Cover with the seafood cocktail sauce.
Add layers of mozzarella cheese, green pepper, and green onions.
Top with diced tomatoes if desired.
Chill until ready to serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

keywords: layered shrimp dip, seafood spread, party dip
